notes: All 6 required web searches ran this time, plus one on Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act cosponsors (7 total). She launched an AI and Energy Working Group in 2025 (energy supply for AI, not risk). Her 2025 remark calling AI 'an incredible weapon' is about the China race and energy; graded D.
